defects.status: fixed, verified by QA on a209660
defects.summary: Anonymous requests count as failed logins; after 10 of them the owner's valid token is refused (429) for the lock-out window
defects.repro: Token mode. From one address send 11 GET /api/projects without credentials, then GET /api/projects with the correct Bearer token -> 429 'too many failed authentications'. Realistic trigger: a tab left open after the 12 h session expiry polls the API.
defects.expected: Requests without any credential do not count as failed authentication; a correct credential is accepted (or only wrong credentials count).
defects.fix: In check(): do not record a failure for reason 'missing'; verify a presented credential before refusing on the lock-out, or lock per (address, presented credential).

defects.status: fixed, verified by QA on a209660
defects.summary: A damaged nexus.db stops the app and `nexus doctor` with a Python traceback (sqlite3.DatabaseError: file is not a database) and no recovery hint
defects.repro: Checkpoint the WAL, delete -wal/-shm, overwrite the first bytes of nexus.db, import nexus.api or run `nexus doctor`.
defects.expected: A plain message naming the damaged file and the recovery command; doctor reports [BAD] database instead of crashing.
defects.fix: Catch sqlite3.DatabaseError where the connection is opened; message: 'nexus.db is damaged; run `nexus restore <new folder>` (backups exist)'. QA verified that `nexus restore` recovers this home.
defects.residual: `nexus serve` prints 'NEXUS running at ...' before it stops with the damaged-database message (cosmetic)

defects.status: fixed, verified by QA on a209660
defects.summary: GET /api/library takes 17.7 s (median of 3; 9.7 s with a category filter); the Asset Library page is blank meanwhile and every filter change refetches
defects.repro: Any home: time GET /api/library. Profile: _registry() re-parses asset_library.yaml with pure-Python PyYAML for each of 183 assets (license_check -> policy -> _registry).
defects.fix: Cache the parsed registry keyed by (mtime_ns, size) and load with CSafeLoader. Measured: 17.7 s -> 0.004 s, payload identical (scripts/qa/bench_assetlib.py).

defects.status: fixed, verified by QA on a209660
defects.summary: Disk full during an upload: HTTP 500, a new empty project is left behind holding a truncated copy (4.6 MB of 18.4 MB) of the video; uploads need ~2x their size transiently (staged in cache, then copied)
defects.repro: NEXUS_HOME on a 40 MB tmpfs; upload an 18 MB video twice.
defects.expected: Free-space check before accepting; on failure no partial file and no orphan project; HTTP 507 with a plain message.
defects.fix: shutil.disk_usage preflight (size x 2 + margin); move instead of copy when on the same filesystem; write to a temp name and os.replace; on error remove the partial file and the project created for this upload.
defects.residual: only the refusal path was live-tested (preflight reserves ~287 MB for 18 MB); a write failure after a passed preflight is covered by Account 1 unit tests only

defects.status: fixed, verified by QA on a209660
files: nexus/ui/index.html go() and async page renderers
defects.summary: A page whose data arrives after the user navigated away overwrites the new page (Storage -> Home shows 'Storage & Backup'); a late handler can throw TypeError (setting onclick of null)
defects.repro: scripts/qa/ui_nav_race.js: go('storage'); go('home') -> main shows Storage & Backup.
defects.fix: go() increments a navigation counter; each renderer captures it and returns after every await if it changed.

defects.status: fixed, verified by QA on a209660
defects.summary: Logout only deletes the cookie; a copied session cookie stays valid until its 12 h TTL
defects.repro: open session, copy cookie, POST /api/v1/studio/logout, reuse cookie -> 200
defects.fix: Session epoch stored server-side (vault/DB), included in the signature; logout bumps it.

defects.status: fixed, verified by QA on a209660
defects.summary: A failed job's API error contains the Python traceback and absolute server paths; an undecodable upload is retried 3 times; its stage stays 'running' after failure
defects.repro: Upload a corrupt .mp4 -> analyze job failed with retries=3, error starts 'FFError: ffprobe failed for /abs/path ... Traceback'
defects.expected: Plain message to the client (traceback in the log); deterministic input errors not retried; stage marked failed.
defects.fix: Split error into message/details; classify FFError 'Invalid data' as permanent.
